critical_code_review_comments: OpportunitiesList.saveMut uses onSuccess invalidateQueries but doesn't surface mutation errors — if PUT /advisor/opps-views 500s the UI will silently roll back on next refetch with no toast. Consider onError toast.error.
window.prompt is used for naming the saved view — works but is ugly/non-themed. Consider a small Modal with an Input for consistency with the rest of the app.
Pending badge is purely cosmetic amber text (not a Badge component) — fine, but using the existing Badge for consistency with status chip above would standardize styling.
